title: graph_version.reverted
description: The pointer went back to an earlier version (D15). entity.id is the hash of the abandoned version; target_version is where the pointer went. A rollback moves a pointer and nothing is erased. A cartografo extension, with no flowpilot equivalent.

graph_id.description: The graph whose pointer went back.

target_version.description: The hash of the version that came to hold again.

reason.description: Why it went back. It is the evidence the topografo will cross-reference with the abandoned version's telemetry.
